chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever loves for the sake of Allah, hates for the sake of Allah, and gives for the sake of Allah, is among those whose faith is complete.

key_terms.أَبْغَضَ لِلَّهِ: hates for the sake of Allah
key_terms.أَحَبَّ لِلَّهِ: loves for the sake of Allah
key_terms.أَعْطَى لِلَّهِ: gives for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: What are the conditions for complete faith according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) defines the perfection of faith through the purification of emotional and material attachments from worldly bias, a concept central to Shia gnosis (irfan). It establishes that true love (mawaddah) and hatred (mubahadah) must be rooted in divine criteria, reflecting the principle of 'Tawhid in Affection' where the believer's heart aligns with Allah's will. This teaching serves as a practical guide for spiritual maturity, ensuring that one's relationships and charity are acts of worship rather than mere social or emotional impulses.

en.shaykh-tahir-ridha-jaffer: 11.Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (a) who said, “
Whoever loves for the sake of Allah, hates for the sake of Allah, and gives for the sake of Allah, is among those whose faith is complete.”
